授業概要
後期では前期を受けて、多文化、多民族共生のための教育に関する研究等について先行研究を基に検討する。
In the first semester, the course proceeds as follows: Based on your own research interests, you will search for existing literature on the target country or region and your research topic, select two or three relevant studies, analyze and evaluate them, and clarify the focus and research questions of your own study. Next, based on the identified focus, you will consider research methods and other aspects of your study.
You will also learn about research methodologies specific to the region in question.
In the second semester, building on the first semester, students examine research and approaches to education for multi-ethnic coexistence based on prior research.
